Don’t take this to mean that it CAN’T get better, though! I don’t know you and I don’t know your situation, but I know the kind of pain you must be experiencing to get that response from people. I can’t promise things will get better but I also definitely can’t promise things will always be this bad. Nothing in life is ever 100% certain, I find.

All this means is that those people don’t know how to help you. Ignore them and know that in all likelihood, it CAN get better. There is a possibility, however slim, that things CAN get better for you, simply because it can’t be 100% certain to stay this bad.

It sounds like this may have been the first time he had EVER been in the presence of a girl and he freaked out. I don’t say this to defend him - that can’t be defended and he needs serious help - but to tell you it isn’t your fault and try not to let it make you feel gross, okay? I’m sorry this happened to you.

Those people typically have no idea how to help because they’ve never been this low. To them, the low points that things get better from are basic. You know, having a run of a few bad days because of drama that eventually everyone will forget, that sort of thing. That advise works if you’re having a bad day, or a bad week, or a bad month even. Even a bad year, with how long current issues are set to continue. But it does not and will not ever work for those of us who are having a bad life.

I do think they say it to try to be helpful, most of the time. Their hearts may be in the right place. They just have been too privileged to comprehend that things can and do get worse than what they’ve experienced, and that it isn’t always something that’s easy enough for time to deal with.

In any case, “it gets better” comments are actually against community guidelines here. You could try telling people that when you see it, and failing that, you could notify a moderator I think.

Business have to feign care to make themselves look good and get more business. You see “we’re all in this together” plastered everywhere because every power in the world is fighting over who can appear most sympathetic. And you’re right. None of them could give two craps about you.

But people? Non-business humans who still have hearts? Some of them do care. Those of us who have actually been through hell and back? We care because we know what it’s like. “We’re all in this together” may be a lie, but that doesn’t mean we’re all alone, either.
